workspace_files.study.md:
# Study
Claim: preregister whether role asymmetry has incremental predictive value. All prompts, topology, model IDs, request parameters, data vintages, horizons, costs, metrics, stopping rules, and restart rules are frozen before outcomes. The asymmetric committee, symmetric committee, strongest single member, and matched-budget control receive identical point-in-time information and matched inference budgets. Calibration data are separate from an untouched confirmatory sample. Dependence-aware inference and the full search family are preregistered. A minimum relevant effect is defined. A prospective forward test and explicit falsification condition are specified. No confirmatory outcomes have been observed.
